Found and fixed a genuine stage-2 data-integrity bug, caught only at stage 6 (a fork correctly refused to simplify corrupted input and halted instead), then independently re-verified before fixing: q_2.1 and q_2.2's item-level solution text was silently truncated right at the sentence immediately preceding their inline source-PDF figure reference - the entire algebraic derivation and final numeric working was missing from both, even though each item's separately-authored final_answer field happened to already hold the correct boxed result, which is how this slipped past stage 5's per-item PDF verification (that stage evidently checked the final answer, not full derivation completeness - a real gap in that pass, not caught by any gate, since gate_math_parity/gate_counts only check structural counts, not prose completeness). A full scan of all 21 items' solution tails against their known correct source endings (from this session's own earlier direct verbatim reads of solutions.en.md) confirmed the bug is isolated to exactly these two items - no other item shows a mid-derivation cutoff. Fixed via pipeline.mdio.markdown_to_chapter() -> mutate Item.solution.en for q_2.1/q_2.2 with the verbatim full text (matching this file's own convention of both figures placed as separate :::figure blocks before :::solution, so the inline "![](...)" markdown lines from the raw solutions.en.md source are correctly omitted from the reconstructed prose, not literally re-inserted) -> pipeline.render.render() -> overwrite 02_extract/chapter.en.md, never hand-edited directly. Round-trip verified via tag._parse and a full diff confirming every other item's solution/part text is byte-identical to before this fix. Stages 3 (split), 4 (combine) and 5 (verify) must be re-run against this corrected chapter.en.md before stage 6 proceeds - their existing outputs still carry the truncated text.

Confirmed \epsilon/arepsilon both map correctly (examples use varepsilon, exercises/solutions use epsilon), \in correctly overridden as the epsilon-zero OCR artifact (not set membership), \circ correctly overridden as degree sign (not composition) - both overrides already proven correct for this exact chapter per step_9/PROMPT.md's own documented history. Three real bugs caught via Playwright visual QA and fixed: (1) literal "**Answer:**" markdown prefix leaking onto the page - stage 8's serializer had not stripped it (mdio.py's own _strip_answer_prefix() convention was missed); fixed by adding the same strip to the stage 8 script and regenerating structured.en.json (re-gated, still PASS: 21 items/31 parts/9 figures unchanged). (2) q_2.1's two figures (nested inside their own steps' flows, not item-level siblings) were being rendered TWICE - once via the item-level "figures before solution" row (which blindly renders every entry in the JSON's flat figures inventory) and again in their correct nested position; fixed by excluding any figure src already found nested inside a solution_blocks flow from that item-level row. (3) A trailing parenthetical remark ending in ".)" (ex_2.4a's "...comes out the same.)") had its sentence-splitter treat the period as a boundary, stranding a lone ")" as its own one-character line; fixed by folding a "." immediately followed by a closing bracket into the same sentence.
